verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Grafana's CLI and as-code tooling are explicitly designed for local development and CI/CD ('suitable for CI/CD pipelines, local development' — grafana-docs-26), and the ecosystem documents 'try it locally' workflows for related components (grafana-docs-29), plus an official CLI (grafana-probe-5) and provisioning-as-code for dashboards/data sources (grafana-docs-2, grafana-docs-3). However, there is no explicit first-party guidance in the pack (e.g., Docker/binary quick-start) for spinning up Grafana itself as a dev instance, nor hands-on community confirmation of this specific workflow. Missing for 10: explicit Grafana-core local install/docker instructions, and independent developer testimony validating ease of local setup for dashboard/instrumentation testing.
